name: warp.green
rootCause: The ERC-20 bridge of warp.green (a cross-chain messaging protocol between Chia and EVM chains) suffered an exploit due to a vulnerability in the Chia-side Chialisp puzzle. The attacker minted worthless CAT tokens, presented them as burned wUSDC, obtained validator signatures, and drained ~$93,000 USDC from the Base and Ethereum bridge contracts, later converting the funds to ETH. The CAT bridge (securing assets like wXCH) appears unaffected.

descriptions.text: The ERC-20 bridge of warp.green (a cross-chain messaging protocol between Chia and EVM chains) suffered an exploit due to a vulnerability in the Chia-side Chialisp puzzle. The attacker minted worthless CAT tokens, presented them as burned wUSDC, obtained validator signatures, and drained ~$93,000 USDC from the Base and Ethereum bridge contracts, later converting the funds to ETH. The CAT bridge (securing assets like wXCH) appears unaffected.

warp.green's ERC-20 cross-chain bridge was exploited on August 23, 2026, resulting in the loss of approximately $93,000 in USDC. The exploitation originated from a logic flaw in the Chia-side bridge module, affecting USDC movements between Chia, Ethereum, and Base. There is no confirmed technical postmortem, on-chain transaction hash, or address available. A logic flaw in the Chia-side module of warp.green's ERC-20 bridge allowed an attacker to present worthless CAT tokens as burned wUSDC, bypassing validator checks and draining bridge funds.
